scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && vite build
scripts.test: rm -rf dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && DATA_DIR=/tmp/code-provider-test node --test dist-test/server/**/*.test.js dist-test/server/**/**/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && DATA_DIR=/tmp/code-provider-test node --test --experimental-test-coverage dist-test/server/**/*.test.js dist-test/server/**/**/*.test.js
